<MethodEndpoint

  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Updates an existing ticket next step template. The template ID in the path must match an existing template.

**Prerequisites**
1. **TicketNextStepTemplateId** - Obtain via [GET /api/v1.0/tickets/next-step/templates](/docs/api/tickets/list-ticket-next-step-templates), extract `Items[].TicketNextStepTemplateId`.
2. **ProductId** - Obtain via [GET /api/v1.0/products/all](/docs/api/products/list-products), extract `Items[].ProductId`.
3. **SiteId** (optional) - Obtain via [GET /api/v2.0/locations](/docs/api/locations/get-my-locations-v-2), extract `Items[].LocationId`.
4. **TicketNextStepTypeId** - Obtain via ticket next step type endpoints.

**Workflow Example**
1. Get existing template: `GET /api/v1.0/tickets/next-step/templates/{TicketNextStepTemplateId}`
2. Modify desired fields in the response body
3. Update template: `POST /api/v1.0/tickets/next-step/templates/{TicketNextStepTemplateId}` with modified body
4. Verify changes by re-fetching the template
